epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false project stagnation warnings to 0
requirements: R1: Fix deliverable readiness calculation logic to correctly incorporate all tasks (resolving the stale 5/19 ratio when 30 tasks are done)

slices.title: Patch deliverable readiness metric calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the calculation fix for this epic, I want to correct the denominator boundary logic, so that the true task progress is reflected without stagnation warnings.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an active project pipeline with more than 19 tasks,
When the readiness metric is calculated,
Then the denominator correctly includes all relevant tasks rather than capping at 19.
Given task completions advance to 30,
When the metric is retrieved,
Then the ratio updates proportionally and triggers no false stagnation warning.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% accuracy for readiness ratio denominator
